mapper.select:
SELECT a.goods_id as spuId, COUNT(DISTINCT a.market_id) as marketNum FROM market_goods_relation a WHERE a.relation_type = 2 AND a.state = 1
AND a.goods_id IN
#{item}
GROUP BY a.goods_id

select sp.id as goods_id,sp.`name`,sp.img,sp.sale_num,mgr.id,mgr.discount_rate,sp.sale_price_began,sp.sale_price_end,sp.state,sp.selection_num,sp.market_price,sp.max_profit,sp.supplier_price_began,sp.supplier_price_end from spu sp left join market_goods_relation mgr on sp.id = mgr.goods_id and market_id = #{req.marketId} and mgr.relation_type = 2 and mgr.state = 1 where sp.audit_state = 2
and sp.name like CONCAT('%',#{req.goodsName},'%')
order by sp.create_time desc

select sd.id, mgr.goods_id,mgr.sell_num,sp.create_time,mgr.market_id,mgr.discount_rate,sp.`name`,sp.img,sp.sale_price_began,sp.sale_price_end,sp.state,sp.selection_num, sp.market_price,(sp.unit_price - sp.sale_price_began) as max_profit,sp.unit_price, (sp.virtual_sale_num + sp.sale_num) as sale_num from market_goods_relation mgr left join spu sp on mgr.goods_id = sp.id left join store_distribution sd on sp.id = sd.goods_id and sd.channel_id = #{req.accountId} and sd.store_id = #{req.accountId} and sd.data_type = 0 where mgr.user_id = #{req.accountId} and mgr.relation_type = 3
